date_semantics: MLB officialDate, inclusive endpoints; UTC event cutoffs
missing_data: refuse; no imputation or fallback challenger

challenger.objective: mean binary log loss + lambda/2 * sum(non-intercept coefficients squared)
challenger.standardization: training mean and population standard deviation only; zero variance -> zero
challenger.tuning: none; no validation or test refit

measures.coverage_denominator: all supplied regular-season schedule occurrences per split
measures.paired_comparison: intersection of labeled games predicted by all three models
